title: A service (S) invoice with no vehicle also lands in the Parts Sales bucket — absence of a vehicle decides, not the prefix
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. A customer has an invoice whose number starts with S but whose work order has NO vehicle (seed a ZZAUTOTEST no-vehicle service work order and invoice it, if the app allows).
steps: 2. Find which asset row the S invoice sits under.
expected: 1. The no-vehicle S invoice appears under that customer's "Parts Sales" row — the bucket collects work by the ABSENCE of a vehicle, not by the invoice-number prefix.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: If the app cannot produce a no-vehicle service invoice, record the seeding path tried and mark Blocked-Env with reason (Standing Rule 14: attempt seeding first).
